Agent Name: Tizin_Translation_Expert
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: They ignored that Maktay functions as “is pleasing to,” making the liker the object and the liked thing the subject. They used apples as the direct object (Zapple) and “I” as the subject (Pa), but it should be “I” as the direct object (Mato) and apples as the subject (Apple), yielding Maktay Mato Apple.
